office_http_500.summary: All 12 Office-write rows (9 denied-role probes + 3 parity reads via getPipeline/listByStatus) fail before reaching any handler: the QA script calls server-function IDs that do not exist on the dev preview server.
evidence: scripts/qa-office-writes.ts:91 fnId = sha256(`${file}--${name}_createServerFn_handler`) — the hashed ID format used by production builds.

The dev preview server's own client code (GET /src/lib/office.functions.ts) uses base64url-JSON IDs, e.g. getPipeline = base64url({"file":"/src/lib/office.functions.ts?tss-serverfn-split","export":"getPipeline_createServerFn_handler"}).

Signed-out read-only probe (no bearer token, cannot authenticate, so no handler body runs): a random 64-zero ID and the script's sha256 getPipeline ID both return the identical HTML 500 'This page didn't load' page; the real dev ID returns a serialised TanStack $TSR/Error (function found). So the script's ID is unregistered on this server.
Without the Origin header both return 403 (CSRF check); the script sends Origin, so that is not the cause.
office_http_500.cause: Wrong server-function ID derivation for the dev/preview target in scripts/qa-office-writes.ts:91 (callFn at :92-100). Consequently 'NOT refused' on denied-role rows means unreachable, not a permission leak; 'DB unchanged' rows confirm no writes happened.
office_http_500.fix_location: scripts/qa-office-writes.ts:91 — derive IDs per target (dev: base64url JSON of {file:'/'+path+'?tss-serverfn-split', export:name+'_createServerFn_handler'}; built: read from the build's server-fn manifest), or read the IDs from the served client module instead of hashing.
office_http_500.handlers_not_mutating_check: getPipeline (office.functions.ts:23) and listByStatus (:43) are GET + requireSupabaseAuth; not invoked authenticated in this diagnosis.
